name: screenfit
description: Mirror phone-only apps to the desktop and refit them for a big screen

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/finalize-preload.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
